note: Frozen tools. The buyer talks to their AI. The AI calls these tools. No paste UI required.

tools.name: list_panels
tools.description: Call this first. Lists Fennsill e-ink panels plugged in over USB on this computer.

tools.name: push_chart
tools.description: Push a clean 800x480 black/white chart to the panel from structured data. Use this whenever the user asks for a graph/chart/plot of data points — do not hand-write HTML. Required: title, labels[], values[] (same length). Optional chart_type: auto|bar|line|hbar|table (default auto). On local USB, device_id is optional.

title.description: Chart headline shown on the panel.

labels.description: Category labels, same order/length as values.

values.description: Numeric series, same order/length as labels.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title.

hold_sec.description: Seconds to keep this page on the panel before the next queued push (default 0).

tools.name: push_artifact
tools.description: Push a custom 800x480 black/white self-contained HTML or SVG page to the panel. Use only for custom dashboards/layouts — for simple graphs from data points, prefer push_chart. No external URLs; inline CSS only; pure black/white high contrast. Prefer html over svg for dashboards. Optional hold_sec keeps the page up before the next queued push. Only report success when the tool confirms the panel refresh.

html.description: Finished 800x480 self-contained HTML. Pure B/W, inline CSS, no external URLs.

svg.description: Finished 800x480 self-contained SVG (same rules as html).

hold_sec.description: Seconds to keep this page on the panel before the next queued push (default 0).

tools.name: start_live_update
tools.description: Start a recurring live feed on the panel (keeps updating without the user pasting). Use for ongoing feeds like NFL scores — not for one-shot charts (use push_chart). kind must be nfl_scores. Default interval_sec is 300.

tools.name: stop_live_update
tools.description: Stop a live feed previously started with start_live_update. Omit kind to stop all live feeds on that panel.

kind.description: Feed to stop. Omit to stop all.

tools.name: set_wifi
tools.description: Send home Wi-Fi name and password to the panel over USB (local only).
